easy.def: A word for me and other people.
examples: Come play with us.
Dad drove us home.
The teacher helped us.

more.def: A word used for the speaker and one or more other people when they are not the ones doing the action.
examples: Our neighbors invited us to their pool party.
The guide showed us how to find animal tracks.
A big wave pushed us back toward the shore.

easy.def: To do something with a thing.
examples: I use a pencil.
She uses a spoon.
We used glue.

more.def: To take something and do a job with it.
examples: Please use a ruler to draw a straight line.
Bats use sound to find food in the dark.
He used the old boxes to build a clubhouse.
A key has one use.
This tool has many uses.
The box has no use.

more.def: The purpose that something serves, or the act of putting it to work.
examples: A hammer has one main use, which is hitting nails.
The use of bikes can help keep the air clean.
Old jars can find a new use as flower vases.

easy.def: Able to help you do something.
examples: A map is useful on a trip.
A bag is useful for carrying books.
Glue is useful for fixing things.

more.def: Helpful; able to be used for a purpose.
examples: A flashlight is a useful thing to bring on a camping trip.
The website has useful tips for new gardeners.
Knowing how to swim is a useful skill.

easy.def: What happens most of the time.
examples: It is the usual time.
I took the usual road.
He had his usual lunch.

more.def: Happening or done most of the time.
examples: We left at the usual time.
She took her usual seat on the bus.
It was a usual day at school.
